blocks.section: Technical advisory notice: PAT testing of Merrychef ovens
blocks.content: While  testing  with  a  Portable  Appliance  Tester  (PAT)  is  not  an  automatic  requirement  for  the  Merrychef  commercial combination microwave oven models, the following notice is to advise on this testing in addition to the following instructions as deemed necessary.

blocks.section: Technical advisory notice: PAT testing of Merrychef ovens
blocks.content: If  the  customer requires  PAT testing  of  the  Merrychef  equipment  we  suggest  this  is  limited to  a)  earth  continuity and  b) insulation resistance (measured at ~ 500 V DC). All Merrychef commercial combination microwave ovens are classified as CLASS 1 for the purpose of testing.

blocks.section: Technical advisory notice: PAT testing of Merrychef ovens
blocks.content: Should it still be deemed necessary by the customer to perform an Earth Leakage test, the following advice should be adhered to. Note that not all PATs are capable of just measuring the leakage or allow you to set a pass limit and therefore may not be appropriate for this test.

blocks.section: Technical advisory notice: PAT testing of Merrychef ovens

blocks.content: Merrychef appliances are fitted with radio interference filters and inverter circuits which cause an increase in leakage current. The PAT may indicate an erroneous failure condition depending on its internal "pass"/"fail" settings. Please refer to the revised limits which apply to the specific Merrychef oven model.
